name: 🎁[Gifting + 3 Chars] DragonBall: Ultimate Clash 2
desc: (If you don't know how to play click the options button in the menu!) Ahh..."DragonBall: Ultimate Clash 2" a sequel to the game "Dragonball: Ultimate Clash". Many upgrades from the first game but you should see for yourself. Anyways, this is a game where you choose your favorite characters and fight friends and enemies alike! Don't hold back! And always have fun! Characters owned by Toei Animation and FUNimation, please support them!
